ga_sessions_<YYYYMMDD>: Holds Google Analytics session-level records; grain = one row per session (visit) identified by visitId and visitStartTime (and visitorId/fullVisitorId/userId); notable keys/measures: visitorId, fullVisitorId, userId, visitId, visitNumber, visitStartTime, date, channelGrouping, socialEngagementType, plus nested objects totals, trafficSource, device, geoNetwork, customDimensions, hits.
